purpose: Design of the /forge:start-design orchestrator skill that builds design documents from requirements through upstream design, existing-pattern matching, detailed design, consistency check, and review.
summary: Overview and flowchart of the design creation workflow
Preparation steps: identify requirements, feature, output dir, temporary marker, completeness, mode, state table, norm documents
Phase 1 rule collection and Phase 2 upstream design from requirements only with approvals
Phase 3 matching with existing implementations and design patterns, redesign, and type determination
Phase 4 detailed design reusing unmodified existing implementations
Phase 5 consistency check with traceability table and Phase 6 AI and user review
Handling of needs not covered by requirements: stop, report, ADR approval record
Completion steps: update-db-specs and commit confirmation
Design principles: build from requirements, reuse existing components, full requirement coverage, What/How boundary
tasks: Modifying the start-design skill or workflow
Judging differential development for design documents
Reusing existing implementations in a design
Handling requirement gaps found during design
